manifest.structural_overlap_interpretation: Random compound split: parent/scaffold groups may cross holdout and CV; reported overlap is not constrained and no structure-isolation claim is made.

holdout_method.seed_selection: One prespecified seed; no model outcomes used or seed search

manifest.data_policy: Original DATA SMILES, specified stereo, names, CIDs and labels unchanged; graph normalization only in grouping copies.
manifest.grouping_policy: Union of seven keys: canonical tautomer parent, v2 protomer parent, original/normalized/tautomer typed Murcko scaffolds, ElementGraph parent/scaffold. ElementGraph conservatively also groups some saturation/redox analogues. Full-parent/scaffold enumeration limits are 1000 tautomers and 1000 transforms; enumeration-independent keys remain enforced.
manifest.acyclic_policy: Empty Murcko scaffolds use parent keys; unrelated acyclic graphs are not put in one empty group. This is not a guarantee against every high-similarity analogue.
manifest.fold_interpretation: Fold k: development fold k validates, other nine development folds train. Test has no CV fold and never enters cross-validation.
manifest.split_selection_policy: Original stratified-random algorithm and seed applied once to current DATA; no features, predictions, test outcomes or seed search used.

source.source_policy: The sole data source is the supplied DATA workbook. No historical tables, cached diagnostic structures, external chemistry records, or prior feature/split files are consulted.
